notes:
• NEW: Live Cameras. On the Cameras tab, click "Live Cameras", type your camera login, and click "Scan Network". MXG Scout sweeps your network for MOBOTIX cameras and lists them in a tree on the left, grouped by name.
• Click any camera to watch it live on the right. The picture is pulled straight from the camera as snapshots several times a second — no video engine, so it starts instantly and works even on cameras the old live view couldn't handle.
• Tick "Remember login" to save your camera password encrypted on this PC (Windows DPAPI).
